reason: Project lens: src/lib/sfx50.6502 is hand-written (only sfx_data.6502 is GENERATED by tools/sfx50.py; grind_config GENERATED/PROTECT do not list it). sfx_tick's only caller is irq1_handler (game.6502 ~4359), after the PROTECTED palette/T1 writes, so its timing places no raster split; after it the handler does PLA/STA romsel/PLA/PLY/PLX/RTI, so the differing A (0 instead of sfx_v on the dv=0 path) and V/flags at RTS are dead. Runs with ROMSEL &05 in both old and new, reads/writes the same bank 5 bytes (sfx_dv, sfx_v, sfx_n); dv=0 old wrote sfx_v back unchanged (ADC 0 with C=0, sfx_v<=&F8 so no carry), new skips the write: same RAM state. dv<0: ADC, C set -> STA (old BCS v_known), C clear -> LDA #0/BRA/STA (old LDA #0/STA). dv>0: ADC, BCC v_known, LDA #&F8, BNE (Z=0 always) - same. All ramp amplitude steps in sfx_data are 0 or negative (checked: 0, 216-254), so the comment is true and the positive path is kept anyway. 'down' referenced nowhere else. Branch ranges all small. Size: old 24 bytes, new 28 (+4); bank 5's end (andy_load + andy size) is &BFEF shipping (17 free) and &BFF5 gameplay (11 free), so it fits; everything after slides by label (sfx_effect tables by LO/HI, compiled_bank5, credits, andy_load), no fixed address or alignment ASSERT among them that a 4-byte slide breaks (the gate assembles every build). Only run in play (irq_owned), so front end, define controls, game over and the completion screen see the same sound state. Cycles: dv<0 no clamp 19->17, dv=0 18->10, dv<0 clamp 20->23, dv>0 no clamp 18->21; weighted by the data (mostly 0 and negative non-clamping) about 4 a channel step, consistent with the claim.
